title: A registered data principal gives consent through the link using her mobile
feature: Consent link: identify, confirm, read the notice, choose, receipt
preconditions: The data-principal portal is open at http://localhost:3001 in a fresh private (incognito) browser window, so no earlier sign-in carries over.

You have the live consent link for the CIT site of the seeded project 'Gait Identification Study 2026' (valid until 8 Oct 2026) from the test coordinator, or one the DCO created from the console in PRJ-18. It looks like http://localhost:3001/c/<long code>.
The test coordinator is available to read six-digit codes from the test outbox and relay them to you.
Anjali Verma (subject@cmp.local, +91 90000 00001) is a registered data principal who has already given her date of birth.
test_data: Choices: 'Gait model training' = I agree; 'Recording quality assurance' = I agree

steps.action: Open the CIT consent link.
steps.expected: The page opens with a coloured banner showing 'Gait Identification Study 2026' and 'CIT'. A step bar shows 'Your details', 'Confirm', 'The notice', 'Done' with 'Your details' current. A card 'Your details' says consent is recorded against your account so you can read and withdraw it.

steps.action: Look at the form before typing anything.
steps.expected: Under 'Send my code to' the 'Mobile' option is already selected ('Email' is the other option). There is ONE box, 'Mobile number', with the hint 'The one your account is registered with.' There is no box for a name, date of birth or a second contact. 'Send the code' is greyed out. Below it: 'No account yet? Create one — it takes a minute, and this page will be waiting when you come back.'

steps.action: Type +91 90000 00001 in 'Mobile number' and click 'Send the code'.
steps.expected: The card changes to 'Confirm your mobile': 'We have sent a six-digit code to +91 90000 00001. It expires in ten minutes.' The step bar moves to 'Confirm'.

steps.action: Type only five digits in 'Six-digit code'.
steps.expected: The box accepts digits only, and 'Confirm and read the notice' stays greyed out.

steps.action: Complete the code with the one the coordinator relays and click 'Confirm and read the notice'.
steps.expected: No date-of-birth question appears (Anjali already gave one). The step bar moves to 'The notice'. A 'Read this in' dropdown shows 'English'. A card 'The notice' shows the notice text (starting 'NOTICE UNDER SECTION 5, DIGITAL PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION ACT 2023'), then 'Data Protection Officer:', 'Who else sees your data:', the links 'Exercise your rights', 'Withdraw consent', 'Complain to the Data Protection Board', and 'Version 1 · content hash …'.

steps.action: Scroll to the card 'What are you agreeing to?'.
steps.expected: Two purposes are listed: 'Gait model training' and 'Recording quality assurance'. Each shows a description, 'What this allows:', 'Data collected:' and 'Kept for:', and two buttons of the same size, 'I agree' and 'I do not agree'. NEITHER button is selected on either purpose. 'Record my choices' is greyed out and the line 'Answer every purpose above, or decline the whole notice.' is shown. 'Decline everything' is active and the same size as 'Record my choices'.

steps.action: Click 'I agree' on 'Gait model training' only.
steps.expected: That choice is highlighted. 'Record my choices' is still greyed out and the line 'Answer every purpose above, or decline the whole notice.' is still shown.

steps.action: On 'Recording quality assurance' click 'I do not agree', then change your mind and click 'I agree'.
steps.expected: The highlight moves from 'I do not agree' to 'I agree'. 'Record my choices' becomes active and the 'Answer every purpose above…' line disappears.

steps.action: Click 'Record my choices'.
steps.expected: The step bar moves to 'Done'. A green tick and the heading 'Your choices are recorded' appear, with 'We have sent you a receipt. You can review or withdraw your consent at any time - withdrawing is as easy as this was.' Below: 'Your reference:' followed by a long code (write it down), and the links 'Review your consents' and 'Your rights'.

steps.action: Ask the coordinator to look in the test outbox for +91 90000 00001.
steps.expected: A receipt message for this consent is in the outbox.

steps.action: Click 'Review your consents'.
steps.expected: The portal page 'Your consents' opens, signed in as Anjali, with a card 'Gait Identification Study 2026', status 'Consented' and the line 'You agreed to 2 of 2 purpose(s).'

pass_criteria: Only one contact and a code were asked for; no purpose was pre-selected; the consent could only be recorded once every purpose was answered; the Done step shows 'Your choices are recorded' with a reference; a receipt was sent; the record shows as Consented, 2 of 2.

title: The link never reveals whether a contact is registered, and a wrong code is refused
feature: Consent link: neutral identification and code check
preconditions: The data-principal portal is open at http://localhost:3001 in a fresh private (incognito) browser window, so no earlier sign-in carries over.

You have the live consent link for the CIT site of the seeded project 'Gait Identification Study 2026' (valid until 8 Oct 2026) from the test coordinator, or one the DCO created from the console in PRJ-18. It looks like http://localhost:3001/c/<long code>.
The test coordinator is available to read six-digit codes from the test outbox and relay them to you.
The coordinator confirms that +91 98100 00002 and tester09@example.org are NOT registered on the platform.
test_data: Wrong code: 123456 (any six digits that are not the code sent)

steps.action: Open the CIT consent link and look at the 'Your details' card.
steps.expected: The line 'No account yet? Create one — …' is already shown, before anything is typed (it is offered to everybody).

steps.action: With 'Mobile' selected, type +91 98100 00002 in 'Mobile number' and click 'Send the code'.
steps.expected: The card changes to 'Confirm your mobile' with 'We have sent a six-digit code to +91 98100 00002. It expires in ten minutes.' There is NO message saying the number is unknown or not registered.

steps.action: Ask the coordinator to check the test outbox for +91 98100 00002.
steps.expected: No message was sent to that number.

steps.action: Type 123456 in 'Six-digit code' and click 'Confirm and read the notice'.
steps.expected: A red message 'Invalid or expired code' appears. The page stays on 'Confirm your mobile' with the code box; no notice is shown.

steps.action: Reload the page. Under 'Send my code to' select 'Email', type tester09@example.org in 'Email address' and click 'Send the code'.
steps.expected: The card 'Confirm your email' says 'We have sent a six-digit code to tester09@example.org. It expires in ten minutes.' Nothing hints that the address is unknown.

steps.action: Reload the page. With 'Mobile' selected type +91 90000 00001 (a registered number) and click 'Send the code'.

steps.action: Clear the box, type the correct code relayed by the coordinator and click 'Confirm and read the notice'.

title: Consent, export, cross-border and import events appear in the audit trail
feature: Console: Audit trail for consent and data exchange
preconditions: Signed in to the console (http://localhost:3000) as Priya Menon, DPO (dpo@cmp.local): on 'Sign in' enter 'Email or username' and 'Password' (SeedPassw0rd!2026), click 'Sign in', then type the 6-digit code relayed by the test coordinator on 'Verify it is you' and click 'Verify and continue'. To change user, use 'Sign out' in the sidebar.
CON-01 to CON-19 have been run (in any order), so the events exist.
test_data: Areas: Consent, Exports, Cross-border transfers, Processors, Imports

steps.action: Under 'Oversight' click 'Audit trail'.
steps.expected: The page 'Audit trail' opens ('Append-only and hash-chained…') with 'Export CSV' and 'Verify chain' buttons, filters 'Area', 'Event', 'Record type', 'Actor role', 'From', 'To' and a 'Search' box, and the columns When, Event, Actor, About, Record.

steps.action: Set 'Area' to 'Consent'.
steps.expected: Entries such as 'Consent given', 'Consent declined' and 'Consent withdrawn' for the test people are listed.

steps.action: Set 'Area' to 'Exports'.
steps.expected: Entries 'Export generated' (Actor Priya Menon, and Meera Iyer from CON-13), 'Export downloaded' and 'Export refused' (from CON-15, CON-16, CON-17) are listed.

steps.action: Click an 'Export refused' row.
steps.expected: A detail panel titled 'Export refused' opens with What, When, Who. It concerns the project and names the processor/cause; it does not name any data principal.

steps.action: Set 'Area' to 'Cross-border transfers'.
steps.expected: 'Transfer country restricted' and 'Transfer country lifted' entries for SG are listed.

steps.action: Set 'Area' to 'Processors'.
steps.expected: 'Processor updated' entries for the SEED country changes and 'Processor created' for UAT No Country Lab Pvt Ltd are listed.

steps.action: Set 'Area' to 'Imports'.
steps.expected: 'Import validated' (one per check), 'Import accepted' and 'Import rejected' entries are listed with Actor Arun Shetty.

steps.action: Click 'Verify chain'.
steps.expected: A green box 'Chain intact' appears.

pass_criteria: Every consent decision, export (generated, downloaded, refused), restricted-country change, processor change and import (validated, accepted, rejected) is in the audit trail, and the chain verifies intact.

title: After an export the principal sees who received her data, and withdraws one purpose while keeping the other
feature: Portal: disclosures and Withdraw just this one
role: Data principal (Anjali Verma); DPO for the last check
preconditions: The data-principal portal is open at http://localhost:3001 in a fresh private (incognito) browser window, so no earlier sign-in carries over.
The test coordinator is available to read six-digit codes from the test outbox and relay them to you.
CON-14 and CON-18 are done (Anjali is in an export; her consent is still 2 of 2).

For the last step: Signed in to the console (http://localhost:3000) as Priya Menon, DPO (dpo@cmp.local): on 'Sign in' enter 'Email or username' and 'Password' (SeedPassw0rd!2026), click 'Sign in', then type the 6-digit code relayed by the test coordinator on 'Verify it is you' and click 'Verify and continue'. To change user, use 'Sign out' in the sidebar.
test_data: Purpose to withdraw: Recording quality assurance

steps.action: Open http://localhost:3001/sign-in. Under 'Sign in with' select 'Mobile', type +91 90000 00001 in 'Mobile number' and click 'Send me a code'. Then type the code the coordinator relays into 'Six-digit code' and click 'Verify'.
steps.expected: After 'Send me a code' a blue box 'Check your messages' says 'If +91 90000 00001 is registered with us, a six-digit code is on its way. It expires in ten minutes.' After 'Verify' the page 'Your consents' opens and 'My consents' is highlighted in the sidebar.

steps.action: Scroll to 'Who your data has been shared with'.
steps.expected: At least one entry names the processor 'SEED' with 'Gait Identification Study 2026 · <date and time>' of the export.

steps.action: On the 'Gait Identification Study 2026' card (status 'Consented') click 'See what you agreed to'.
steps.expected: Both purposes show 'Consented', each with a 'Withdraw just this one' button.

steps.action: Click 'Withdraw just this one' under 'Recording quality assurance'.
steps.expected: The notice 'Withdrawal recorded' / 'Stopped: Recording quality assurance.' appears.

steps.action: Look at the card.
steps.expected: The line reads 'You agreed to 1 of 2 purpose(s).' 'Recording quality assurance' now shows 'Declined' and 'Gait model training' still shows 'Consented'. The status badge reads 'Partial', not 'Withdrawn'.

steps.action: Look for a way to withdraw the remaining purpose, 'Gait model training'.
steps.expected: A 'Withdraw just this one' button is still offered under 'Gait model training' (and 'Withdraw everything' on the card), so the rest can be withdrawn as easily as consent was given (s.6(4)).

steps.action: Click 'What was recorded'.
steps.expected: The list shows the original consent followed by the withdrawal.

steps.action: Ask the coordinator to check the outbox for Anjali.
steps.expected: A withdrawal confirmation message is present.

steps.action: In the console as the DPO open 'Consents' > 'Anjali Verma'.
steps.expected: The record shows the warning 'This record is a withdrawal'; 'Purposes' shows 'Gait model training' Agreed and 'Recording quality assurance' Not agreed. Its status reads 'Partial', not 'Withdrawn'.

pass_criteria: The principal sees the processor her data went to; withdrawing one purpose stops only that purpose, the other remains agreed, and she can still withdraw the remaining purpose from the same page.
